answer: The most enriched biological process in the ASXL1-mutated fibroblasts is NEURONAL DEVELOPMENT — specifically GO-BP "neuron projection development" (GO:0007413). The disease (ASXL1-mutated) vs control comparison shows a strong up-regulation of neuronal/neural-development genes, and among the top up-regulated protein-coding genes this term has by far the highest representation (15/30 genes; empirical hypergeometric p ≈ 2.5e-10), well ahead of the next terms cell adhesion (8/30) and synapse organization (6/30). Representative up-regulated driver genes: contactins CNTN4/CNTN6, ion channels SCN2B (+ KCNMB1/KCNIP1/ANO2), receptors CHRM3, planar-cell-polarity/neural-tube gene VANGL2, neural transcription factors ISL2/ALX4, and synaptic/adhesion proteins CTNND2, VSNL1, PRRG3, LUZP2 (plus SNAP25, GABRA3, SCN5A, PITX1, APBA2 in the broader up-regulated set).
